mapper.sql: id, code, name, type, parent_id, path, method, sort, enabled, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.parent_id, p.path, p.method, p.sort, p.enabled, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.deleted FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND rp.deleted = 0 AND p.enabled = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
SELECT p.id FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND rp.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
